topics.label: Introduction to the Hallmarks of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning outcomes and outlines the framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated Growth Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic and tumor suppressor mutations alter cell-surface and intracellular signaling cascades to drive sustained proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Block to Differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells arrest in progenitor or incomplete stages of lineage development using examples from hematopoiesis and the intestinal crypt.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how disruptions in the p53 and BCL2 family regulatory pathways enable cancer cells to avoid programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how telomere dynamics and senescence signaling regulate cellular lifespan and how tumors bypass these mechanisms.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the shifts toward aerobic glycolysis, metabolic rewiring, and the role of oncometabolites in tumor progression.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the necessity, timing, and molecular regulation of new blood vessel recruitment to support tumor growth.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic covers the metastatic cascade, diagnostic tracking methods, and genetic factors governing tumor spread to distant sites.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Conclusions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic summarizes the collective significance of cancer hallmarks and concludes the lecture.
